# Authority Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AuthorityLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The claimed authority grade of a norm within its issuing system — an ordered value vocabulary (absolute ≻ high ≻ medium ≻ conditional), the kernel [`GranularityLevel`](gmeow-GranularityLevel.md) pattern. The ordering is carried by [`gmeow:strongerThan`](../properties/gmeow-strongerThan.md) on the LEVELS; what the ordering does to conflicting norms is solver work over recorded precedence claims, never a reasoner entailment ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the ordered value vocabulary for the authority-grade axis — the seeded levels (absolute ≻ high ≻ medium ≻ conditional) a norm claims via [`gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel`](../properties/gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-level subclasses (levels are individuals) and avoid treating the ordering as a reasoner entailment over norms — level comparison resolving conflicts is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Reference the seeded levels from a norm via [`gmeow:hasAuthorityLevel`](../properties/gmeow-hasAuthorityLevel.md) and order them with [`gmeow:strongerThan`](../properties/gmeow-strongerThan.md) on the levels; extend the ladder by minting a fresh individual ordered into it.

### Examples

- ex:authorityStatutory a [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md); [`gmeow:strongerThan`](../properties/gmeow-strongerThan.md) [`gmeow:authorityMedium`](../individuals/gmeow-authorityMedium.md).
